## The Senior Caregiver Agency That Bergen County Trusts

Senior Helpers Bergen County is the premier provider of in-home senior care. We offer tailored home care services ranging from companion care for seniors who need daily assistance to in-depth specialized care for those with Alzheimer’s, Dementia, Parkinson’s and other chronic diseases in the area.
## Not sure what type of care?

Senior Helpers offers a comprehensive suite of programs and services that support aging in-place. Choose from the following list below or learn more on our [services overview](https://www.seniorhelpers.com/nj/bergen-county/services/) page.

Our Senior Gems program helps individuals with Alzheimer's and dementia stay engaged and safe at home by matching care techniques, activities, and communication styles to their specific stage of cognitive change.
Our caregivers complete a specialized certification that prepares them to manage the unique mobility, medication timing, and daily living needs of those with Parkinson's disease.
Our companion care services pair friendly, one-on-one interaction with practical help around the house and on errands, keeping your loved one engaged, supported, and comfortable at home.

Our caregivers are specifically trained to respectfully handle intimate, non-medical care tasks, from bathing and grooming to mobility assistance, backed by care manager assessments that keep support aligned with your loved one's changing needs.

Transitional care services help seniors return and stay home safely following a hospital or long-term care facility stay with personalized support built around recovery goals, home safety, and the support needed to prevent falls, setbacks, and readmissions.

Our caregivers provide hands-on, non-medical support for seniors living with chronic conditions -from heart disease to arthritis, diabetes, and osteoporosis - helping with daily routines, comfort, and quality of life.
We partner with professional assistance organizations to help veterans and their spouses secure the benefits they deserve while we begin providing quality in-home care right away.
Our respite services provide family caregivers with time to rest, recharge, or tend to other responsibilities, knowing their loved one is receiving attentive, professional care at home.

Our professional caregivers can provide around-the-clock bedside companionship and monitoring support for your loved one before, during, and after a hospital stay, ensuring they have a familiar, attentive presence whenever family can't be there.
Working alongside local hospice providers, our specially trained caregivers offer around-the-clock comfort and emotional support for your loved one and family during this difficult time.

Senior Helpers’ Concierge Care program is a collaborative agreement with assisted, independent, and continuing care retirement communities to provide additional in-home support and services to community residents.

### Does In-Home Care for Seniors Help Reduce Blood Pressure and Hypertension?
In-home care helps reduce seniors’ blood pressure by creating a calm environment, improving diet, ensuring medication consistency, and providing companionship to support heart health.
### Senior Care At Home vs. Facility : The Key Differences Explained
